Imagine waking up... and watching the ocean rise into the sky!
Not a tsunami. Not a storm.
Every ocean on Earth is floating into space!
Within minutes, enormous walls of water rise above entire cities.
Ships crash onto the exposed ocean floor.
Billions of sea creatures are left stranded as the water disappears.
But here's where things get terrifying...
Without oceans, Earth loses its biggest climate regulator.
Rainfall patterns collapse. Temperatures become extreme. Entire ecosystems begin to die.
Earth's gravity is powerful enough to keep our oceans right where they are!
To lift that much water into space, you'd need an unimaginably powerful force overcoming gravity.
So if the oceans really started rising...
The scariest question wouldn't be where the water was going.
It would be... WHAT is powerful enough to take it?
